checkpoint_selection: maximum validation mean per-case mass Dice; empty/empty=1

prediction.case_latency_scope: legacy serial case wall including preprocessing and export; excludes status/checkpoint hash writes

model_only_inference.scope: No standardized CUDA-event forward benchmark has been recorded; CT case timings cannot substitute.

definitions.epoch_totals: Observed committed epoch logs only; missing checkpoint times remain missing. Parent and current segments are separate, not independent seeds.
definitions.stage_cost: Current workspace invocations only, including failures/cancellations. Allocation is not utilization. Parent allocation is not copied or double-counted.
definitions.case_numbers: One-based positions in frozen validation partition; no scan or patient identifiers published.
definitions.inference_seconds: Tiled pipeline including host/device transfers, model forward, softmax and CPU blending; not model-only latency.
definitions.percentiles: Inclusive linear p95 over recorded case wall times; heterogeneous CT sizes and queue time prevent a standardized model-speed claim.

resources.timing_definition: Finished stage allocation plus separately shown active-stage wall estimate; not GPU utilization

followup_experiment.description: Matched 10,000-update DynUNet with two native decoder auxiliary losses
